name: Local Multi-Control (多角色冒险)
author: liwenhao0427
description: Control 2-12 characters by yourself in official multiplayer — real multiplayer rules, no network. Community-maintained continuation (v1.31+) with the original author's blessing. 单人多角色本地多控，原作者授权社区接手维护。
tag: local multi-control 本地多控 多角色
detail: One player controls 2-12 characters on one machine: Tab/Shift+Tab to switch, per-character decks/gold/potions/relics/choices, Vakuu AI auto-play, optional ghost-hands overlay (F8 toggle, Ctrl+Arrows to move). v1.33: Silken Tress fixed, ghost-hands fixes, optional cross-character card rewards. Entry: Multiplayer -> Host -> Local Multi-Control. 进入方式：多人模式 -> 创建 -> 单人多角色；Tab 切人，F8 队友手牌。
